creators.name: Ninh Tito (Ninh eating)
creators.credible: Verifiably popular Vietnamese food vlogger: YouTube ~394K subscribers, Instagram @ninheating ~140K followers with strong engagement; a real 'food storyteller' with a long track record of street-food videos. CAVEAT: his content is predominantly Hanoi-focused, so he was NOT used as a source for any HCMC place in this pass; listed only as a vetted, real Vietnamese food KOL for future cross-city use.

note: All 35 HCMC street-food places in FOOD_HCMC_VN_STREET.json cleared the >=2-credible-source bar on Vietnamese-language EDITORIAL OUTLETS alone (VnExpress/Ngoi Sao, Thanh Nien, Nguoi Lao Dong, ZNews, Kenh14), so no KOL was relied on as a load-bearing source. KOL identification was cut short by the WebSearch budget (200/200 used); Ninh Tito is the only creator whose real following AND a findable body of work were confirmed within budget. Others named in the brief (Khoai Lang Thang, Woossi/우기, An Sap Sai Gon, Dia Diem An Uong, Sai Gon An Vat, Duy Nen, Hoang Nhi, Bep Cua Vo) were NOT vetted here to avoid fabricating following/attribution.
